name: blockbench-mcp-pro
description: 最完善的 Blockbench MCP —— 插件内进程 HTTP(S) MCP + stdio 网关双通道

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bbmcp/shared && npm run build -w @anningui/blockbench-mcp && npm run build -w @bbmcp/gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bbmcp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @anningui/blockbench-mcp && npm run typecheck -w @bbmcp/gateway
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @bbmcp/shared && npm run test -w @anningui/blockbench-mcp && npm run test -w @bbmcp/gateway
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
